gaps.sentence: Please carry ___ with your work; don't mind me.
gaps.explanation: carry on = continue; carry out = perform (a task).

gaps.sentence: Lawyers are drawing ___ the contract now.
gaps.explanation: draw up = prepare and write (a contract, list, plan).

gaps.sentence: Don't leave ___ any details in your report.
I can't make ___ what the sign says from here.
gaps.explanation: make out = see, hear or understand with difficulty.

gaps.sentence: Let's start ___ — the first version had too many errors.
gaps.explanation: start over = begin again from the beginning.

gaps.sentence: The negotiators refused to give ___ to the hijackers' demands.
gaps.explanation: give in (to) = stop arguing and accept; give up = quit.

gaps.sentence: The strike brought ___ major changes in the law.
